subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the documentation redirects are added and the stack is rebased, should the exact final head be authorized to remove the qa-matrix workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: Repository policy deliberately blocks dependency-graph changes until an administrator or security owner confirms that the exact reviewed SHA contains the intended removal and no unexpected resolution changes.

options.title: Fix, rebase, and authorize
options.body: Add both redirects, rebase after the prerequisite stack lands, rerun review, and authorize the exact resulting dependency-removal SHA.

options.title: Defer package removal
options.body: Keep the temporary package and compatibility facade until maintainers choose a later removal window with a stable base.

recommendation.title: Fix, rebase, and authorize
recommendation.body: Add both redirects, rebase after the prerequisite stack lands, rerun review, and authorize the exact resulting dependency-removal SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available repository-level routing candidate for the exact-head authorization, with Matrix feature owners available to confirm the intended ownership boundary.
